command:
cat > /root/ansible/encrypted-volume.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Provide an auto-unlocking encrypted volume at /srv/secure
  hosts: secure
  become: true
  vars:
    luks_key_dir: /etc/luks-keys
    luks_key_file: /etc/luks-keys/secure.key
    backing_dir: /var/lib/secure-volume
    backing_file: /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
    mapper_name: secure
    mount_path: /srv/secure
    volume_size_mb: 512

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure cryptsetup is installed
      package:
        name: cryptsetup
        state: present

    - name: Ensure LUKS keyfile directory exists
      file:
        path: "{{ luks_key_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0700"

    - name: Generate random LUKS keyfile
      command: openssl rand -out {{ luks_key_file }} 4096
      args:
        creates: "{{ luks_key_file }}"

    - name: Restrict keyfile permissions
      file:
        path: "{{ luks_key_file }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0400"

    - name: Ensure backing volume directory exists
      file:
        path: "{{ backing_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0700"

    - name: Create backing file for encrypted volume
      command: fallocate -l {{ volume_size_mb }}M {{ backing_file }}
      args:
        creates: "{{ backing_file }}"

    - name: Restrict backing file permissions
      file:
        path: "{{ backing_file }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0600"

    - name: Check whether backing file is already a LUKS volume
      command: cryptsetup isLuks {{ backing_file }}
      register: luks_check
      failed_when: false
      changed_when: false

    - name: Format backing file with LUKS
      command: cryptsetup luksFormat --batch-mode {{ backing_file }} --key-file {{ luks_key_file }}
      when: luks_check.rc != 0

    - name: Ensure crypttab entry for the volume
      lineinfile:
        path: /etc/crypttab
        regexp: '^{{ mapper_name }}\s'
        line: "{{ mapper_name }} {{ backing_file }} {{ luks_key_file }} luks,nofail"
        create: true

    - name: Open the LUKS volume now (idempotent)
      command: cryptsetup open --key-file {{ luks_key_file }} {{ backing_file }} {{ mapper_name }}
      args:
        creates: "/dev/mapper/{{ mapper_name }}"

    - name: Check filesystem type on the mapped device
      command: blkid -o value -s TYPE /dev/mapper/{{ mapper_name }}
      register: fstype_check
      failed_when: false
      changed_when: false

    - name: Create ext4 filesystem on the mapped device
      filesystem:
        fstype: ext4
        dev: "/dev/mapper/{{ mapper_name }}"
      when: fstype_check.stdout == ""

    - name: Ensure mount point exists
      file:
        path: "{{ mount_path }}"
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0700"

    - name: Ensure fstab entry and mount the encrypted volume
      mount:
        path: "{{ mount_path }}"
        src: "/dev/mapper/{{ mapper_name }}"
        fstype: ext4
        opts: defaults,nofail
        state: mounted

    - name: Reload systemd to pick up crypttab changes
      systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
EOF
echo WROTE
